name: Four Seasons Maui at Wailea
insider_take: This oceanfront sanctuary sits on one of Maui's most pristine beaches, where ancient Hawaiian royalty once walked and world-class whale watching happens right from your balcony.
whats_special: The resort occupies 15 acres of the exclusive Wailea coastline, featuring three cascading pools that seem to flow directly into the Pacific. The property is built on lava rock formations that create natural tide pools, and its Wailea Beach consistently ranks among America's best beaches. The resort's indigenous plant collection includes over 100 species of native Hawaiian flora.
pro_tip: Visit during humpback whale season (December-April) when you can spot whales breaching directly from the beach - the resort provides complimentary binoculars at the concierge desk.
dont_miss: The sunset ceremony at Wailea Point, where traditional Hawaiian conch shell blowing marks each evening. Also explore the resort's art collection featuring works by renowned Hawaiian artists, and snorkel at the protected Wailea Beach where Hawaiian green sea turtles frequently visit the shallow reefs.
pros: Prime Wailea beachfront location with pristine white sand beach
Exceptional Four Seasons service and hospitality standards
Multiple award-winning dining venues and world-class spa
Family-friendly amenities including kids' club and activities
cons: Resort can feel crowded during peak seasons
